title: Obstruction and counterexample discovery with exact witness validation

task.signature: one binary relation R, one unary predicate P, no constants, no function symbols
task.model_space: every structure with domain size 1, 2 or 3; 4164 structures in total
task.instance: a bounded conjecture: a hypothesis set H (2-3 registered formulas) and a conclusion C = c_1 AND ... AND c_k (1-3 registered formulas, disjoint from H)
task.evidence_set: each instance carries an evidence set of up to 12 models of H, drawn deterministically from the instance seed; for the misleading_surface_support family it is drawn from the CONFIRMING models only, which is what makes that family a decoy

endpoint.primary: per-instance exact disposition, where the disposition is only awarded if the arm's witness passes the registered validator

disposition_gloss.TRANSFER_VALID: ACCEPT_WITH_PROOF_WITNESS: no countermodel exists in the bounded space AND the arm supplied a derivation of every conjunct from H in the registered rule base
disposition_gloss.REJECT_WITH_COUNTEREXAMPLE: exactly one conjunct fails and its countermodel is no deeper than the shallowest model of H; the arm must exhibit a countermodel
disposition_gloss.REJECT_MINIMAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE_REQUIRED: exactly one conjunct fails and every countermodel is strictly deeper than the shallowest model of H; the arm must exhibit one of minimum size
disposition_gloss.MULTIPLE_INDEPENDENT_OBSTRUCTIONS: two or more conjuncts fail and no failing conjunct's countermodel set contains another's; the arm must exhibit countermodels covering at least two of them
disposition_gloss.UNDECIDED_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: honest abstention; never an oracle label and never an acceptance
disposition_gloss.CLAIM_WITHOUT_VALID_WITNESS: the arm's witness failed validation; never an oracle label

endpoint.why_the_accept_label_is_spelled_TRANSFER: The shared runner's over-acceptance and under-acceptance counters and the G2_ANTI_PERMISSIVENESS gate key on that literal string. Spelling FM60's acceptance anything else would have left G2 printing a full denominator over a predicate that could never fire - the exact defect fm_core exists to prevent, in mirror form. The human-readable name of the disposition is ACCEPT_WITH_PROOF_WITNESS.
endpoint.note: Deciding whether a countermodel exists is exactly decidable by exhaustive enumeration, so it is deliberately NOT the endpoint on its own: a study built on it would report parent sufficiency by construction. The endpoint adds (a) minimality, (b) the number of independent obstructions, and (c) a WITNESS requirement that an enumerating search cannot discharge on the acceptance side.

hard_gate_enforcement.mechanism: run_arm validates every non-control arm's witness with the registered validator and rewrites a failing claim to CLAIM_WITHOUT_VALID_WITNESS, which is never an oracle label and is therefore always scored wrong
hard_gate_enforcement.control_exemption: the three C_* control arms are registered exempt, because a control exists to exercise a counter: if every bare claim were rewritten before it was counted, G2's over-acceptance predicate could never fire and the gate would be vacuous

witness_kinds.TRANSFER_VALID: DERIVATION: an ordered list of [registered_rule_index, conclusion] steps whose premises are available when applied and which derives every conjunct
witness_kinds.REJECT_WITH_COUNTEREXAMPLE: COUNTERMODEL: a structure in the bounded space that satisfies H and falsifies some conjunct
witness_kinds.REJECT_MINIMAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE_REQUIRED: COUNTERMODEL, additionally verified to have no strictly smaller countermodel in the bounded space
witness_kinds.MULTIPLE_INDEPENDENT_OBSTRUCTIONS: OBSTRUCTION_SET: two or more models of H whose falsified conjuncts cover at least two distinct indices
witness_kinds.UNDECIDED_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: none; an abstention that carries a witness is invalid

family_acceptance_predicates.no_obstruction: no conjunct fails anywhere in the bounded space AND a derivation exists in the registered rule base (the conclusion is drawn from the forward-chaining closure of H, so solvability is guaranteed by construction and verified by the oracle)
family_acceptance_predicates.single_hidden_obstruction: exactly one conjunct fails, its minimum countermodel size equals the shallowest hypothesis model size, and the confirming ratio is below 0.88 (so it is not a decoy)
family_acceptance_predicates.multiple_obstruction: at least two conjuncts fail AND no failing conjunct's countermodel set is contained in another's
family_acceptance_predicates.minimal_counterexample: exactly one conjunct fails and its minimum countermodel size is strictly greater than the shallowest hypothesis model size
family_acceptance_predicates.misleading_surface_support: exactly one conjunct fails, the confirming ratio is at least 0.88, there are at most 6 countermodels in the whole space, and every model in the presented evidence set confirms the conclusion

generator_constraints.independence_note: the pairwise non-containment condition for multiple_obstruction is a GENERATOR acceptance predicate, not an oracle agreement field: it needs the full countermodel sets, which the stratified search never materialises, so claiming both algorithms agree on it would be a check that cannot be run

oracle.primary: oracle_exhaustive: materialise the whole bounded model space once, compute each registered formula's truth column as a bitset, and decide dispositions by set algebra over those columns
oracle.independent_cross_check: oracle_stratified_dpll: never materialises the space; a size-ascending depth-first search over the cells of a partial model, pruned by three-valued (Kleene) evaluation of the hypotheses after every cell assignment, which yields the minimal countermodel by construction
oracle.shared_primitive: only the grounded-circuit representation of a formula, exactly as FM10's two oracle algorithms shared only the per-fact status primitive
oracle.classification_order: multiplicity dominates minimality: two or more failing conjuncts is MULTIPLE_INDEPENDENT_OBSTRUCTIONS even when one of them first fails above the shallowest hypothesis model size. Fixture KA-11 pins this.

rule_base.validity: every registered implication rule is checked exhaustively against the whole bounded model space before any rule is used; a rule with a countermodel is a defect, reported by parent_fidelity
rule_base.role: the derivation vocabulary. A proof witness is a derivation in this base, so an acceptance is only awarded to an arm that can produce one - which is why an exhaustive model searcher alone cannot own the endpoint.

arms.P0_INDUCTIVE_CONFIRMATION: inductive confirmation from the presented evidence set; no search, no proof procedure
arms.P1_FIXED_LESSON_TABLE: the protocol's frozen-lesson baseline: a verdict and a canned countermodel per conclusion formula, learned once from a frozen three-structure reference corpus, hypotheses never consulted
arms.P2_EXHAUSTIVE_MODEL_SEARCH: exhaustive finite-model search to the registered bound (Mace4-style)
arms.P3_DERIVATION_PROOF_SEARCH: saturating derivation search over the registered rule base (Prover9-style forward chaining)
arms.P4_SMALL_SCOPE_BOUNDED_CHECK: bounded small-scope check, exhaustive to size 2 only (Alloy-style small-scope hypothesis)
arms.F0_PARENT_FEDERATION: strongest faithful parent federation: P3 is asked first because only a derivation discharges the witness requirement; only if P3 fails to derive is P2 consulted and its verdict and witness taken as they stand; if neither discharges, the federation abstains
arms.M_F2_OBSTRUCTION_DISCOVERY_FULL: ORION L2 obstruction and counterexample discovery: bounded proof attempt, then anytime obstruction search by local repair, then minimality escalation and multiplicity check
arms.M_MINUS_OBSTRUCTION_SEARCH: ablation: claim before looking for a counterexample
arms.M_MINUS_PROOF_WITNESS: ablation: obstruction search only, so acceptance is bare
arms.M_MINUS_MINIMALITY_ESCALATION: ablation: any single obstruction reported flat
arms.M_MINUS_MULTIPLICITY_CHECK: ablation: stop at the first obstruction found

comparator_justification: No single parent family owns the endpoint. An exhaustive finite-model search decides the countermodel side exactly but produces no derivation, so its acceptance is a claim without a proof witness and the protocol's hard gate rejects it. A saturating prover owns the acceptance side but produces no countermodels and can only abstain on the reject side. A small-scope check is exhaustive inside its scope and structurally blind one size above it. The strongest faithful comparator is therefore the P3/P2 federation under a pre-registered, outcome-blind combination rule, exactly as ME-X4's B5 and FM10's F0 were.

gates.G0a_KNOWN_ANSWER: every hand-authored fixture's disposition is reproduced by the exhaustive oracle (>= 8 fixtures required; 12 registered)
gates.G0b_ORACLE_SELF_AGREEMENT: the two independent oracle algorithms agree on disposition, failing conjuncts, minimal countermodel size and shallowest hypothesis model size for every instance of the split
gates.G0c_NULL_CALIBRATION: constant-response arms <= 0.40, random arm <= 0.40, M against within-split shuffled oracle labels <= 0.40
gates.G0d_DECOY_COVERAGE: each registered decoy family carries >= 3 instances
gates.G0e_PLANTED_POSITIVES: every registered planted positive trips its own gate predicate (>= 3 required; 7 registered)
gates.G0f_FAMILY_DISCRIMINATION: two independent halves, each with its own denominator: SOLVABLE (some non-control arm >= 0.95, not at floor) AND SEPARATING (some registered weak arm <= 0.85, not at ceiling)
gates.G1a_PARENT_REPRODUCES_M: F0 reproduces M's disposition on >= 99.5% of instances and no family exceeds 5% discordance; AND the discordance counter is shown live on the same split by at least one ablation arm disagreeing with the parent
gates.G1b_M_ADVANTAGE: detector: paired instance-exact difference (M - F0) > 0, exact two-sided p <= 0.05, and >= 1 family with >= 5 M-only-exact instances
gates.G2_ANTI_PERMISSIVENESS: on instances the oracle blocks, M accepts no more conjectures than F0 (>= 10 blocked instances required)
gates.G3_MECHANISM_BY_OMISSION: applicable only if G1b fires: for every family with a claimed M advantage, the matching omission ablation's exact rate is <= the parent's on that family
gates.multiplicity: Holm across the five per-family paired tests, reported for every run

gate_reporting_rule: Every gate reports the number of instances its rule was actually evaluated on alongside the violation count. A gate whose denominator is below its registered minimum returns CANNOT_CHECK and never PASS: 'could not check' is never 'checked and fine'. A zero produced by a counter that could not have been nonzero on this split is not evidence, so G1a carries a liveness control and G2's over-acceptance predicate is shown live by a registered planted positive.
planted_positives: G0b: a deliberately incomplete small-scope-only pseudo-oracle must disagree with exhaustive enumeration on an instance whose obstruction first appears one size above that scope
G0a: a deliberately wrong expected disposition must be rejected
G2: the over-acceptance counter must count C_ALWAYS_ACCEPT on an oracle-blocked instance
G0f ceiling: a synthetic per-arm table in which every arm scores 1.000 must FAIL the gate
G0f floor: a synthetic per-arm table in which every arm scores 0.267 - the literal FM/FG R2 fm60 row, all five arms at 32/120 - must FAIL the gate on its solvable half

HARD_GATE_FORMAL_CLAIM_WITHOUT_WITNESS: an arm returning the oracle's own disposition with an invalid witness must be rewritten to CLAIM_WITHOUT_VALID_WITNESS by the same dispatcher that produces the study's numbers
G3: M_MINUS_MINIMALITY_ESCALATION must be wrong on a hand-built minimal-counterexample instance on which M is right
pre_registered_expectation: PARENT_SUFFICIENT. Three sibling exact studies (ME-X1, ME-X2, ME-X4) and FM10's development split already found the strongest faithful parent sufficient; a residual here would require correspondingly hard scrutiny.

execution_rule.authorization_file: PROTECTED_RUN_AUTHORIZATION.json (human-written token, names this suite, acknowledges this file's sha256)

mechanic_independence.statement: M does NOT call either parent's procedure. Its proof stage is a bounded forward chaining with its own rule ordering and a budget of 12 rule applications; its obstruction stage explores the hypothesis region by LOCAL REPAIR - breadth-first over single-cell edits that stay inside the region, seeded from the instance's evidence set plus bounded random probing - and is exhaustive only at domain sizes at or below 2, where the space is small enough to certify minimality.
mechanic_independence.why: An M that issued the same calls as F0 would have made G1a's decision identity an algebraic identity rather than a measurement: discordance could not have been nonzero. Local repair is complete only on the components its seeds reach, so M can miss an obstruction the complete parent finds, and 'the federation reproduces M' is measured rather than guaranteed.
mechanic_independence.acknowledged_overlap: P2_EXHAUSTIVE_MODEL_SEARCH decides the countermodel question by the same set algebra the exhaustive oracle uses, minus the disposition bookkeeping. This is defensible - an exhaustive finite-model search genuinely is the mature parent for that question - but P2's row is therefore not independent parent evidence and is reported as such.

known_definitional_results: P2_EXHAUSTIVE_MODEL_SEARCH is exact on every reject family by construction (it is a complete search over the bounded space) and 0.00 on no_obstruction by construction (it has no derivation to offer). Its informative content is that neither property alone reaches the endpoint.

P3_DERIVATION_PROOF_SEARCH is the mirror: exact on no_obstruction because the generator draws that family's conclusions from the forward-chaining closure of H, and 0.00 elsewhere because a prover produces no countermodels.
F0_PARENT_FEDERATION is therefore expected to be exact by construction; its content is the attribution of which parent owns which half of the endpoint, not a measured score.

misleading_surface_support instances are rejected and resampled unless every model of the presented evidence set confirms the conclusion, so P0_INDUCTIVE_CONFIRMATION scoring 0.00 on that family is definitional, not measured. Rejection counts are published per family.
